steps.en: Add its integration to your Astro config
steps.zh: 在 Astro 配置里加上它的集成

steps.en: Wrap a server-only async function in server$ next to your component
steps.zh: 在组件旁用 server$ 包一个只在服务端跑的异步函数

steps.en: At build time, keeps the body in the server bundle and swaps a fetch stub into the client bundle
steps.zh: 构建时把函数体留在服务端包，客户端包换成发请求的替身

steps.en: In your server entry, hand matching requests to its handler
steps.zh: 在服务端入口里把命中的请求交给它的处理器

steps.en: A browser call POSTs the arguments as JSON, runs the function on the server and returns the result
steps.zh: 浏览器调用时把参数按 JSON POST 过去，在服务端执行并返回结果

value.en: One function call from a component replaces a hand-written API route and fetch wrapper, and server-only code stays out of the browser bundle
value.zh: 组件里一次函数调用，替掉手写的 API 路由和 fetch 包装，服务端代码也不会进浏览器包

sources: README.md server$ section (import { server$ } from '@tanstack/bling'; client makes a fetch call, POST by default)
packages/bling/src/vite.ts (vite-plugin-bling transform: compileFile / compileSecretFile / splitFile via Babel)
packages/bling/src/server.ts (handler registry, JSON.parse of payload, JSON.stringify of results)
